ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ProTop needs access to your photos to change profile and family pictures.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: ProTop needs the camera to scan barcodes on groceries and ISBNs on books.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ProTop uses your location for weather, your home address and Family Location — only when you ask or sharing is on.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: ProTop uses Face ID to lock the app and protect your account.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ProTop needs the microphone for voice notes.
